issues.implementation_acceptance: Each required action resolves to a real registered producer and client; success, refusal, unknown and recovery have independently observed postconditions. A missing binding blocks BG-001.
issues.title: The complete executable consumer catalogue is still a deliverable

issues.implementation_acceptance: Traceable results cover every required action and state family; altering the postcondition or pointing a test at a sibling action causes the relevant acceptance to fail.
issues.title: Inventory preservation does not yet provide executable per-action acceptance

issues.implementation_acceptance: Every feature primary has a reviewed acceptance obligation in the generated plan or an explicit delegation with shared exit evidence; no feature is certified solely by an unrelated unit.
issues.title: 22 feature tests omit their declared primary frontend owner

issues.implementation_acceptance: A fresh S24 installation reaches the intended authorized services without host/port/token entry; expired/replayed provisioning refuses; rotation and recovery work without reviving a revoked device.
issues.title: Zero-configuration bootstrap needs an executable identity and recovery protocol

issues.implementation_acceptance: Positive conversations and action readback run through real speech providers; ambiguous amounts/accounts require resolution; late audio/recognition cannot restart a cancelled turn or duplicate a command; spoken done follows verified effect, not transcript receipt.
issues.title: Conversation and spoken responses need a complete turn/audio contract

issues.implementation_acceptance: Each supported mode has actual OS readback; unsupported background behaviour is clearly surfaced with an accessible supported alternative and no silent recording.
issues.title: Floating and voice lifecycle need a declared Android support matrix

issues.implementation_acceptance: Exact source tests establish repairs, and independent evidence supports each promoted policy/model at its declared scope. No profitability label follows solely from model capability or winning trades.
issues.title: Strong trading specifications still need source repairs and economic proof

issues.implementation_acceptance: Required integrations have current permitted positive and refusal paths. Unsupported is a truthful state, not a way to count a required feature as complete; hosted fallback is tested where allowed.
issues.title: Provider capability and entitlement remain external dependencies

issues.implementation_acceptance: One event remains one incident across channels; revoked/expired actions cannot execute from old notifications; critical state remains visible even when OS delivery is blocked.
issues.title: Notification and cross-surface state policy needs a complete delivery matrix

issues.implementation_acceptance: Concurrent edits and late callbacks cannot overwrite newer state; unknown effects reconcile original operations; cancellation of a UI request never falsely reports native work cancelled.
issues.title: Work, agents, browser, automation and studio require operation-level lifecycle tables

issues.implementation_acceptance: A scoped erasure is traceable through each applicable store/processor and re-index/restore path; inaccessible or retained exceptions remain disclosed rather than reported as deleted.
issues.title: Privacy and erasure need a verifiable store-by-store lifecycle

issues.implementation_acceptance: Representative load, dependency outage and restore drills meet the declared budgets or visibly degrade within policy; success is not inferred from an open port or healthy process.
issues.title: Recovery and capacity obligations need measurable operational budgets

issues.implementation_acceptance: The actual signed release installs/upgrades without orphaning owner/device state; incompatible versions refuse safely; rollback never restores obsolete authority or loses financial truth.

issues.implementation_acceptance: Negative tests fail at authoritative boundaries and leave correct receipts/state; display checks or sanitized screenshots alone cannot certify authorization.
issues.title: Cross-domain security needs an explicit adversarial surface matrix

issues.implementation_acceptance: Actual S24 receipts and accessibility/performance evidence certify the declared context/state matrix; visual degradation preserves essential controls and financial values.
issues.title: Readability, navigation and performance remain rendered-device obligations

issues.implementation_acceptance: Current source/config/provider/build receipts support every applicable obligation and required independent/native gate. No counter, schema checker, simulator or emulator is relabelled as complete product/device evidence.
